name: Image administration
description: Every picture added anywhere in Chronicle is also entered in the sprite contract of the image administration program (sprite-admin) and sent to it, so the picture can be managed and replaced there.

config.label: Contract folder
config.help: The folder with the sprites.contract.yml of the project. Nothing happens until this is set.

config.label: Folder for Chronicle's contract files
config.help: Inside the contract folder. The root contract must include it, for example include: [contracts/*.json].

config.label: Delivery folder
config.help: Where the pictures are delivered, relative to the project root of the contract.

config.label: Send the picture too
config.help: Off: only the contract entry is written, and the picture is delivered later by hand.

actions.label: Add existing pictures
actions.help: Enters every picture that was uploaded before this plugin was turned on.

actions.label: Send waiting pictures again
actions.help: Tries again for pictures that image administration did not accept.
